description: Gruntas for Codex: each event runs `gruntas hook codex <event>`, which tells the gruntas daemon about the session and never rewrites a tool call; it refuses only what the paste guards refuse, and Stop reminds the agent to report its status (gruntas_report) after work it has not reported. Without gruntas on the PATH the hooks do nothing, and SessionStart says how to install it.

hooks.command: command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '{"systemMessage":"gruntas is not on the PATH, so this session is not registered with it. Install it: curl -fsSL https://gruntas.com/install | bash"}'; exit 0; }; exec gruntas hook codex SessionStart
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook codex SessionEnd
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook codex PreToolUse
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook codex PostToolUse
command -v gruntas >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec gruntas hook codex Stop
